cn_title: 马赫沙拉·阿里告别《刀锋战士》
subtitle: 不再等了
summary: 马赫沙拉·阿里确认，漫威影业的《刀锋战士》项目已告吹，他也不再参与。该片自2019年公布后多次改动，演员与幕后成员陆续离开；漫威会否另寻主演继续推进，仍未可知。
opus_summary: 马赫沙拉·阿里确认，漫威影业的《刀锋战士》项目已告吹，他也不再参与。该片自2019年公布后多次改动，演员与幕后成员陆续离开；漫威会否另寻主演继续推进，仍未可知。

paragraphs.en: Mahershala Ali has confirmed his Blade movie is dead and he has officially moved on from the troubled Marvel project.
paragraphs.cn: 马赫沙拉·阿里确认，他主演的《刀锋战士》电影已告吹，自己也正式告别这个一波三折的漫威项目。

paragraphs.en: In an interview with GQ , Ali said that if Marvel Studios ever does get around to making a Blade movie, it won’t be with him.
paragraphs.cn: 阿里接受GQ采访时表示，即使漫威影业最终拍成一部《刀锋战士》电影，主演也不会是他。

paragraphs.en: “The best way I can answer this question is, when I look at what is for me, is it was either this or that — and I'll take this,” Ali said, referencing his new movie, Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother.
paragraphs.cn: 阿里提到自己的新片《Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother》时说：「我能给出最好的回答是，回看什么适合我，当时只能二选一——这个或那个，而我选择了这个。」

paragraphs.en: “No offense to them. I've been doing this professionally for pushing 30 years now, and one thing I've learned is that what is for you is for you and what is not is not. For whatever reason, that project is not for me. If they wanted to do it, we would've done it. So I have to move on, and I have moved on. Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother feels very much in alignment with the type of work I want to be known for. I don't really want to be known for remakes. I’d love to do original work that resonates with people and impacts them in unique ways.”
paragraphs.cn: 「无意冒犯他们。我从事这行快30年了，学到的一件事是：该属于你的，自会属于你；不属于你的，就不属于你。无论出于什么原因，那个项目都不适合我。要是他们想拍，早就拍了。所以我得向前走，而且已经走出来了。《Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother》很符合我希望别人认识到的作品类型。我其实不想以翻拍作品闻名；我想做能打动人、以独特方式影响人的原创作品。」

paragraphs.en: “So, I'm good,” he continued, laughing. “Again, you had me under contract, they have billions of dollars, if they wanted to do the movie, we would've done the movie. So we're not doing the movie. When I look at this and Blade, I couldn't have done both, and the reason this even exists is because that project fell apart and Bassam [Tariq, director who was helming Blade before stepping down in 2022] had the time, space, energy, and focus to go and write this and then re-approach me.
paragraphs.cn: 他笑着继续说：「所以，我挺好的。再说一遍，你们曾和我签约，他们坐拥数十亿美元；要是他们想拍这部电影，我们早就拍了。所以这部电影不会拍。回头看这部片和《刀锋战士》，我不可能两边都做；而这部片之所以能出现，是因为那个项目散了，Bassam Tariq（曾执导《刀锋战士》、后于2022年退出的导演）才有时间、空间、精力和专注去写它，然后再来找我。」

paragraphs.en: “And I was able to use those skills that I had been working on for over a year training for Blade. In that way, I feel creatively redeemed on some level, just in my own journey between me, myself, and I. But I feel ready to move on from the Blade questions. Those questions are for them. They didn't want to do it, so they should answer that question.”
paragraphs.cn: 「而且，我能把为《刀锋战士》训练一年多时练出的那些技能用上。从某种层面说，在我自己的创作历程中，这让我挽回了一些遗憾。但我已经准备好不再回答《刀锋战士》的问题了。那些问题该问他们；他们不想拍，所以该由他们回答。」

paragraphs.en: Earlier this month, Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige admitted he felt like a “gigantic loser and failure” over the collapse of Ali's Blade reboot . Marvel announced it was making Blade back in 2019 at San Diego Comic-Con, and confirmed that Ali would feature as a new version of its vampire hunter, previously played by Wesley Snipes. But, seven years later, the project is dead in the water, despite the apparent enthusiasm from Ali to make it.
paragraphs.cn: 本月早些时候，漫威影业掌门人凯文·费奇承认，阿里的《刀锋战士》重启项目夭折让他觉得自己是个「巨大的输家和失败者」。漫威2019年在圣迭戈漫展宣布制作《刀锋战士》，并确认阿里将饰演新版吸血鬼猎人；此前这一角色由韦斯利·斯奈普斯扮演。但七年过去了，尽管阿里显然很想拍成此片，项目仍已停摆。

paragraphs.en: "We've landed on modern day," in an interview last summer, acknowledging that Blade's script had gone through "three or four" different incarnations, two of which were period pieces. "We didn't feel like, as we often do, you can have a good script and make it a great script through production," Feige continued, discussing why the project had been pushed back. "We didn't feel confident that we could do that on Blade, and we didn't want to do that to Mahershala and didn't want to do that to us."
paragraphs.cn: 费奇去年夏天表示：「我们最终决定采用现代背景。」他承认剧本经历了「三到四个」版本，其中两个是年代戏。他解释延期原因：「有时剧本不错，我们能在制作中把它变得出色；但我们对《刀锋战士》没有这种信心，也不想这样对待马赫沙拉或我们自己。」

paragraphs.en: In December, Mia Goth said she got a wig to wear for the 1920s Blade movie idea , before the setting was scrapped and the project was placed on hiatus. "The furthest that it got with me was... I flew to Atlanta and did a chemistry test with Mahershala," Goth said, speaking on the Josh Horowitz podcast. "I did a costume fitting and a wig fitting. I was very excited in the direction it was going and Mahershala had such an interesting take on it, he was great. And it just unravelled from there, unfortunately."
paragraphs.cn: 去年12月，米娅·高斯说，她曾为一版设定在1920年代的《刀锋战士》构想配过假发；后来这一时代背景被放弃，项目也暂停了。她在Josh Horowitz的播客中说：「我参与到的最远一步是……我飞到亚特兰大，和马赫沙拉做了化学反应测试。我试了服装，也试了假发。我很期待它的发展方向，马赫沙拉对此有非常有意思的理解，他很棒。可惜后来就从那里开始散了。」

paragraphs.en: Alongside Mia Goth's wig, fans know that a full wardrobe of clothes was made for the film's supporting artists, which were ultimately sold on . Bizarrely, these ended up being used in another period vampire movie, Ryan Coogler's acclaimed Sinners .
paragraphs.cn: 除高斯的假发外，影片还为群演制作了整套服装，最终被出售。离奇的是，这些服装后来用在瑞恩·库格勒广受好评的年代吸血鬼电影《罪人》中。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Wesley Snipes reprised his role for a cameo in Deadpool & Wolverine. Deadpool actor Ryan Reynolds has said he wants Snipes' classic Marvel movie hero to get a send-off film akin to Hugh Jackman's Logan .
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，韦斯利·斯奈普斯在《死侍与金刚狼》中客串回归。瑞安·雷诺兹表示，希望斯奈普斯的经典漫威英雄能获得一部类似休·杰克曼《金刚狼3》的告别电影。

paragraphs.en: In 2024, Snipes poked fun at the MIA film after news surfaced that director Yann Demange had reportedly exited the project. "Blade, lordylordylordy folks still lookin for the secret sauce, ridin snowmobiles in traffic, kinda rough," Snipes said. "Daywalkers make it look easy, don't they?"
paragraphs.cn: 2024年，有消息称导演Yann Demange据报道已退出项目，斯奈普斯随后调侃这部「失踪」的电影：「《刀锋战士》啊，天啊天啊，各位还在找秘方呢，在车流里骑雪地摩托，挺难搞的。日行者让这事看起来很轻松，不是吗？」

paragraphs.en: And in May last year, David S. Goyer, who wrote all three movies in the original Blade trilogy and even directed 2004’s Blade: Trinity, wondered what was taking so long .
paragraphs.cn: 去年5月，为原版三部曲编剧并执导2004年《刀锋战士3》的David S. Goyer也疑惑为何拖了这么久。

paragraphs.en: “I would,” Goyer responded when asked if he’d write Marvel’s Blade reboot. “I’ve always loved the character and I love him. I’ve been sitting on the sidelines wondering, ‘What in the world is going on? Why is it taking so long?’ Because I’m a huge Marvel fan myself, and I’ve just been totally puzzled.”
paragraphs.cn: 被问是否愿为漫威重启版编剧时，Goyer回答：「我愿意。我一直喜欢这个角色，也喜欢他。我一直在旁边想：到底怎么回事？为什么这么久？我自己就是漫威铁粉，完全想不通。」

paragraphs.en: The question now is, will Marvel Studios find a replacement for Ali and push forward with a new take on Blade, or give up entirely? With Ryan Gosling confirmed to be playing Ghost Rider in a new MCU movie set for release in 2028, some believe Marvel Studios is setting up the introduction of the Midnight Sons, which would potentially open the door for Blade.
paragraphs.cn: 现在的问题是，漫威影业会为阿里另寻人选，以新版本继续推进《刀锋战士》，还是彻底放弃？瑞恩·高斯林已确认将在一部定于2028年上映的新MCU电影中饰演《恶灵骑士》；有人认为，漫威影业正在为Midnight Sons的登场铺路，这可能为《刀锋战士》打开机会。
